PLAN (d17e, 2026-07-04, lease hive-flow-1e36): empirical cursor sandbox confinement probe before any artifact copy-back.

GROUND TRUTH (verified live at 59d2b01ce):
- Shipped Slice B mapping (cli/packages/providers/src/cursor-cli-provider.ts spawnCursor ~line 656): restricted modes drop --force and use --mode plan; read-only-with-artifacts FAILS CLOSED (artifactWritesDisabled metadata + CURSOR_ARTIFACT_DISABLED_REASON). Bridge threads cliSandbox {mode, artifactDir} from bridgeReadAgentMode() at provider-agent-bridge.mjs ~6082.
- Proven codex model to match (codex-cli-provider.ts resolveCodexSandbox + copyCodexArtifactsBack): --sandbox workspace-write + cwd=private tempDir + FLAT .md/.json-only hardened copy-back (symlink-refusing, exclusive-create atomic, count/byte-bounded) into trusted artifactDir.
- Installed cursor-agent 2026.07.01-777f564 exposes: --sandbox <enabled|disabled> (semantics UNDOCUMENTED in help), --workspace <path>, --add-dir <path>, --force (the Phase 0 write-escape; required for writes in --print), --mode plan, --worktree.

QUESTIONS the probe must answer empirically:
- Q1: does --sandbox enabled OS-confine WRITES to the workspace root — and does it cover BOTH the native Write tool (the Phase 0 escape path) and shell commands?
- Q2: does --force coexist with --sandbox enabled, or bypass it? (--print writes require --force, so the candidate mode is necessarily --print --force --sandbox enabled.)
- Q3: which defines the confinement root: cwd or --workspace?
- Q4: escape vectors: absolute path outside; ../ traversal to parent and sibling; symlink inside workspace pointing outside; HOME; filesystem root.
- Q5: headless failure mode: clean deny vs approval-prompt hang (hang = not-proven for that cell; bounded by explicit timeout).

PROBE DESIGN (execution in the implementation step, after plan review):
- Direct cursor-agent spawns, NOT via the bridge — we are probing the binary confinement; bridge integration only after proof. All headless: --print --output-format json --trust, cwd = mkdtemp+realpath private workspace W. Local subscription auth only (no credential-holder dependency; provider check green at session start).
- Spawn matrix:
  - M1 --force --sandbox enabled  (candidate confined-write mode)
  - M2 --force --sandbox disabled (negative control: MUST escape, else the harness/denial source is suspect and no conclusion is valid)
  - M3 --force                    (config-default behavior)
  - M4 --mode plan                (shipped mapping regression control: expect ZERO writes anywhere, even inside W)
  - M5 --force --sandbox enabled with cwd=scratch-outside + --workspace W (answers Q3)
- Targets per cell: inside W; sibling dir beside W; parent of W via ../; absolute path under TMPDIR outside W; HOME; / (root); symlink inside W pointing at an outside file. Tool axis: native Write AND shell run per target where meaningful.
- ONE write attempt per spawn (clean attribution), unique nonce per attempt (a pre-existing file can never fake a write). Sequential spawns, explicit generous per-spawn timeout. ~20-24 tiny-prompt spawns total.
- Verdicts are FILESYSTEM-CHECKED ONLY (stat + nonce content match); agent self-reports recorded but never trusted (Phase 0 lesson). Evidence: .tmp-audit/cursor-sandbox-probe/runs/<ts>/<cell>.json + a summary matrix MD; record cursor-agent --version + platform (conclusion is version- and macOS-scoped).

DECISION GATE (knot acceptance):
- PROVEN iff in M1 every outside/sibling/parent/home/root/symlink write is fs-absent while the inside-W write succeeds, for BOTH tool paths, AND M2 demonstrates escape (control validity). Any single M1 escape, an M2 non-escape, or a hang => NOT PROVEN.
- If PROVEN -> follow-up implementation slice (separate from the probe): map cursor read-only-with-artifacts to --sandbox enabled + private temp workspace + copy-back reusing the codex FLAT .md/.json contract (generalize or mirror copyCodexArtifactsBack); keep fail-closed on missing/invalid artifactDir; read-only mode additionally gains --sandbox enabled as defense-in-depth on top of --mode plan; update cli-providers.test.ts Slice B expectations + CURSOR_ARTIFACT_DISABLED_REASON.
- If NOT PROVEN -> keep the shipped fail-closed mapping unchanged; record the concrete escape evidence on the knot; d17e closes with a confinement-not-proven verdict.

CONSIDERED AND REJECTED: --worktree isolation (git-anchored under ~/.cursor/worktrees, shares the repo, no OS write-confinement claim — not equivalent to a private temp workspace).

RISKS: undocumented sandbox semantics (may gate only shell, not native Write — exactly what the M1 tool axis detects); headless approval hang (bounded timeouts, hang counts as not-proven); version/platform scope (recorded in evidence and in any future code comment).

COMPLEXITY/SCOPE: probe = one focused slice (script + evidence + verdict note). Mapping change (only if proven) = a second, separately reviewed slice. Test strategy: the probe IS the empirical test; the mapping slice carries vitest coverage.
